title: annotations
description: One user's annotations for one book (sync/annotations/{user}/{book}.json). The only mutable layer; merged server-authoritatively by last-writer-wins with tombstones (DESIGN §4.5, §12).

book_id.description: Permanent book identifier these annotations belong to.

user_id.description: Id of the household profile that owns these annotations (matches users[].id).

annotations.description: All annotations, including tombstones (deleted=true), for last-writer-wins merge.

id.description: Client-generated stable id (UUID) for the annotation; merge key.

type.description: Annotation kind: a text highlight, a note (highlight plus body text), or a page-level bookmark.

page_id.description: Zero-padded 4-digit page id the annotation anchors to.

anchor.description: Character range within the page's immutable text. Offsets are UTF-16 code-unit offsets, because that is what the browser's Selection/Range API yields; the server never interprets them (DESIGN §4.5). A bookmark uses {start:0,end:0} (page-level).

start.description: Inclusive start offset (UTF-16 code units) into the page text.

end.description: Exclusive end offset (UTF-16 code units) into the page text; >= start.

text.description: Note body. Present only for type='note'.

color.description: Highlight color. Present for highlight/note; absent for bookmark.

modified.description: ISO-8601 UTC last-modified timestamp; drives last-writer-wins merge (DESIGN §12).

deleted.description: Tombstone flag. When true the annotation is deleted but retained for merge convergence (DESIGN §12).
